name: deputy
description: Deputize cheap models. Claude stays the sheriff. A cheap model, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, reviews Claude's code for bugs and gives second opinions, for under a cent each. Claude keeps writing the code; an optional savings mode delegates coding work.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: accuracy (recommended): Claude writes all code, Deputy only gives second opinions and reviews. lean: as few Claude tokens as possible with little accuracy loss; Deputy does the reading and larger well-specified work. balanced: Deputy also takes low-risk mechanical work. partner: Deputy does all low-level work and gives ideas; Claude checks everything. savings: Deputy takes most coding work.

deepinfra_api_key.title: DeepInfra API key
deepinfra_api_key.description: Your key from deepinfra.com (Dashboard > API Keys). Stored in your system's secure storage. Leave empty to use the DEEPINFRA_API_KEY environment variable instead.

thinking.title: Thinking level
thinking.description: How hard DeepSeek thinks. high is the recommended default; max is slower and costs more.

lead_model.title: Your Claude model (for the savings estimate)
lead_model.description: Which Claude model you usually run. Deputy prices its savings estimate against it.
